newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine stocks slip in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Argentine stocks slip in late trading.

text.p: Argentine stocks eased towards the close Wednesday, taking their cue from a sharp drop on Wall Street, dealers said.

"We were heading higher today but it was very difficult to stay in positive territory while the Dow slumped," one trader said. "However the good sign is volume remains tight, so the market should find it easy to rebound."
The blue-chip MerVal index erased slim early gains and fell 0.6 percent to 682.67. Losers were led by foods giant Molinos and carmaker Ciadea, off 2.6 percent and 2.1 percent.
